name: full_text_search
description: Lexical full-text search over operational evidence (PostgreSQL tsvector, ts_rank_cd). Best for exact identifiers and keyword matches, e.g. a Jira key like ORION-1489. Query terms are OR-combined so a natural-language question still ranks strong lexical hits first.

query.description: Free-text query or exact identifier to match lexically.

source_systems.description: Restrict to systems: slack, jira, confluence, salesforce, github.

name: vector_search
description: Semantic similarity search using pgvector cosine distance over Cohere embed-v4 (1024-d) embeddings, HNSW-indexed. Best for conceptual matches and paraphrases where the exact words differ from the source text.

query.description: Natural-language query; embedded with Cohere embed-v4 before the cosine search.

name: fuzzy_match
description: Typo-tolerant fuzzy match using pg_trgm trigram similarity over titles and leading chunk text. Best when an identifier or name may be misspelled or partially remembered, e.g. 'OR10N-1489'.

query.description: Approximate term, name, or identifier to match by trigram similarity.

threshold.description: Minimum similarity (0-1) required to return a row.

name: hybrid_search
description: Fused ranking that combines full-text, semantic, and fuzzy signals with Reciprocal Rank Fusion plus metadata and recency scoring. The default choice for open-ended operational questions where the best evidence may be lexical, semantic, or both.
